== Summary ==
Original Japanese printing of [[Anakin's Lightsaber (Japanese)]], from the Japanese Limited [[Hoth (Japanese)]] edition. Extracted unchanged from the original embedded image on p. 43 of the collecting encyclopedia.<ref name="hoth-japanese-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source PDF SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">07bb3a1fbdd1a65f6cafdff1fca821108ff8210c82da70a10b988ea7539d1665</code>. Embedded image xref: 2052. Original image SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">f7f919c0843248d97f016c6d71b429fdb7ced26503ed5bd526b5408de9b6e3a3</code>. No resizing, cropping, retouching or reconstruction.

Copyright text on the card credits Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998. The image documents the historical card printing.
